problem: The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 1 and g(x) = 2x - 5. What is the value of f(g(4))?

bad.why: Invalid: the intersection of f and g solves f(x)=g(x), which has nothing to do with the composition f(g(4)).
There is no condition to test the choices against; the composition is a single evaluation.

algebraFirst.description: Computes g(4)=3 by hand, then substitutes into f to get f(3)=9-12+1=-2.

explanationNotes: f(g(4)) means 'do g first, then f': g(4) = 3, then f(3) = -2. Typing f(g(4)) into Desmos does both steps in the right order; note that g(f(4)) = -3 is the reversed-order trap among the choices.
